description:
Do you love creating elegant solutions to complex challenges? Do you see the importance in every detail? As part of our Silicon Technologies group, you'll help ensure Apple products and services run seamlessly and efficiently for millions of users.

In this hands-on role, you will partner with Post-Silicon teams, including Product and Test Engineering (PTE), Digital Custom Group (DCG), Silicon Validation (SiVal), and Design for Test (DFT). You will architect, build, and support the automated infrastructure these teams rely on for data management and data processing. You will also help shape a new end-to-end flow that takes a chip from test pattern to production-ready test program. Depending on team needs, you may also develop software for memory failure analysis.

Description
Our North Star is to create, monitor, and maintain high-quality infrastructure and flows that enable Hardware Technology to produce the chips behind Apple's best products. You will help extend that vision to every silicon team.

We are working closely with the Product and Test Engineering (PTE) team to build a full pipeline for test program creation. Our flow is growing beyond test pattern management into end-to-end test program creation, with fewer manual handoffs and a faster path from design intent to silicon in the tester. This is a rare chance to help define the architecture of a flow that will shape how Apple tests its chips for years to come. Your work will be used by the engineers who bring up every new silicon.

You will join an energized, highly motivated CAD team that supports Apple's chip design efforts end to end.

Responsibilities
Architect, develop, and support post-silicon infrastructure systems, which may include EMA, Memory Failure Analysis, Silicon Validation, Test Patterns, and eFuses.
Help design and build the end-to-end test program creation pipeline in partnership with TE, from test pattern management through finished test programs.
Lead large-scale infrastructure projects from specification through development and deployment.
Build and maintain databases, services, and automated pipelines for data extraction, validation, and signoff.
Monitor the health of production flows, and drive resolution of complex issues.
Apply automation and AI-assisted tooling to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
Promote these systems across Apple Silicon design teams.
Set and advocate software engineering standards, and mentor other engineers.
Write documentation and provide training for internal customers.
Engage with internal customers and cross-functional partners to continually improve workflows and systems.

Minimum qualifications
BS in Computer Science, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Experience with Python, Perl, or C++.
Experience working in Linux/Unix environments.

Preferred qualifications
10+ years of relevant industry experience.
Experience driving large-scale system infrastructure from specification and development through deployment.
Experience with post-silicon infrastructure, such as test programs, test patterns, eFuses, EMAs, or Memory Failure Analysis.
Familiarity with ATE or test program development flows.
A track record of championing software engineering practices: agile, code review, automated builds, regression testing, and version control.
Experience with databases, data pipelines, and web or API-based tools.
Experience supporting internal customers.
Familiarity with applying LLMs or agent-based automation to engineering workflows.
